{{Quote|Cliegg Lars. Shmi is my wife.|Cliegg introduces himself to his stepson, Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Episode 2" />}}
'''Cliegg Lars''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the widower of [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]], the step-grandfather of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], the stepfather of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and the father of [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]]. He was the son of [[Gredda Lars/Legends|Gredda]] and [[Lef Lars/Legends|Lef Lars]], and was the elder brother of [[Edern Lars/Legends|Edern Lars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Thirty of us went out after her. Four of us came back. I'd be with them, but&hellip; after I lost my leg I just couldn't ride anymore, until I heal. I don't want to give up on her, but she's been gone a month. There's little hope she's lasted this long.|Cliegg Lars tells Anakin Skywalker about his mother|<ref name="Episode 2" />}}
[[File:ClieggLarsDetail-SWE.png|thumb|left|200px|Lars in a power chair after losing his right leg]]
Cliegg's father was a kind [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farmer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], but the young Cliegg rebelled against the elder Lars and left Tatooine for the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Ator/Legends|Ator]]. He [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a young woman named [[Aika Lars/Legends|Aika]], and they had a son, [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen]].<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

Aika [[Death/Legends|died]] during Owen's youth, and a devastated Cliegg returned to Tatooine with his son, made amends with his father, and took over the [[Lars homestead/Legends|family farm]].<ref name="NEGTC" /> In [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]],<ref name="UVG">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> he purchased the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] from [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] and subsequently freed and married her.<ref name="NEGTC" /> Shmi often told her new family how much she missed her son, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin]], who had been freed by a [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Jedi]] to join the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] [[32 BBY/Legends|years before]].

[[22 BBY/Legends|Years later]], he was visited on Tatooine by Anakin and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and told them that Shmi had been abducted by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]. Cliegg and 29 other settlers attempted to rescue her, but 26 of the settlers were killed and Cliegg lost his right leg from the midthigh down, due to a<ref name="SWEIIAotCN" /> monofilament<ref name="Depth">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> trap laid by the Tusken Raiders. This forced him to use a [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|power chair]] in order to move around as he refused to use a mechno-limb.<ref name="SWEIIAotCN">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones'' (novel)]]</ref>

Anakin set off to rescue her, and eventually brought Shmi's body back to the Lars homestead, where she was [[Funeral of Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|buried]] alongside Cliegg's [[Edern Lars/Legends|brother]] and [[Parent/Legends|parents]].<ref name="ItW AotC">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>

Cliegg died shortly thereafter from his injury and a broken heart, leaving Owen and Beru to watch over the Lars homestead. He was 62 years old when he died.<ref name="SWI103">{{InsiderCite|103|Ask Lobot}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Some sources use an alternate spelling of "Cliegg", one of which is "Cleag".

Cliegg Lars was played by [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australian]] actor [[Jack Thompson]].
